change: Developer-tools-only native application UI frame observer and bounded host runner. No production widget, routing, saved-graph or normal application service change.
measurement_context: Sequential native runs with source fixed and no concurrent Cargo validation. Actual WGPU/Metal-rendered application UI, continuous repaint, stationary bundled graphs with document-restored pan/zoom and panel layout. Unavailable execution/host services, isolated eframe preferences, no app save, pointer/keyboard/drop input suppressed. Warmup 30 valid previous-frame CPU observations, then 120 observations. UI-start intervals pair with the previous CPU frame, not display completion. Viewport/render configuration changes during sampling fail the run. Optional screenshots occur only after all timing samples. Counts are input-document counts, not independent post-load topology or fallback checks. No GPU timestamps, presentation latency, live execution, large-graph scale acceptance, drag frames, or before/after speedup claim. Retained runs use the final validated executable; earlier smoke runs are not pooled. These are host-sensitive observations, not stable performance thresholds.
